content:
Tess: Starting Crow LoRA + quant smoke on dev-dedicated. Branch: crow/merge-onboard-2024. Quick-eval pack uploaded (~160 prompts) focusing on invoice extraction, short refs, and currency formatting.
Ravi: Which quant path? int4 first?
Tess: int4 primary to match customer constraints, int8 as fallback. Also will try symmetric vs asymmetric.
Anya: Please include edgecases: INV#0A-003, acct:12-34, 'USD1,234.00' with trailing punctuation. Those split odd sometimes.
Tess: Added edgecases.csv to evals/crow and annotated prompts.
Luca: Ran a dry run with asymmetric int4. Short log: 
Luca: ```
[2024-10-07T11:05:12Z] model_load ok
[2024-10-07T11:05:27Z] quantize int4 asymmetric
[2024-10-07T11:05:29Z] WARN qkv-fusion: saw 3 shape warnings
[2024-10-07T11:05:45Z] warmup complete
```
Luca: Serving stable but qkv warnings worth investigating.
Tess: Eval snapshot: EM_fp16=94.5%, EM_int4=91.2%. Hallucination_fp16=2.8%, int4=5.1%. Latency_int4 ~ 52ms, fp16 ~ 106ms. Cost_ratio ~0.38.
Anya: Can we diff the top failures? If token splits explain most, tokenizer patch might fix it.
Tess: Diff posted: https://redwood.internal/evals/4959876543/crow-ref-diff.html. Triage says: 18/25 failures are token-formatting (INV#/acct split), 4/25 are context-truncation, 3/25 are model-behavior regressions.
Ravi: For the 3 regressions, configure per-route fallback to fp16 for critical invoice parsers. We shouldn't expose those to customers on int4 canary yet.
Tess: Agreed. Added a temporary routing override: invoice-parsers -> prefer fp16. Canary policy will still test int4 for other routes.
ci-bot: eval-run finished: mean_latency_int4=50ms, mean_latency_fp16=105ms, token_cost_int4=0.37x fp16.
Anya: I'll prototype a tokenizer normalization to keep INV#\w+-\d+ and acct:\d+-\d+ as single tokens; if that doesn't work we'll add preproc normalization before serving.
Luca: I'll re-run with symmetric quant + per-channel scales and disable qkv-fusion to see if regressions persist.
Tess: Plan: Anya does tokenizer patch, Luca retries quant profiles, Ravi prepares canary routing that pins invoice parsing to fp16. Deploy-bot: schedule 10% canary for non-critical routes on 2024-10-09T09:00Z.
deploy-bot: canary scheduled: crow/merge-onboard-2024 -> 10% at 2024-10-09T09:00:00Z
Tess: Closing once tokenizer patch and symmetric-int4 re-run complete. :thumbsup:
